title: 美国PPI超预期：油价上涨还没算进去，美联储又多一层复杂？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's get to that economic data. PPI and jobless claims. Mike McKee has the numbers.
segments.zh: 来看经济数据。PPI和失业金申请。Mike McKee带来具体数字。

segments.en: Hey Mike. Good morning John. Well, that's not particularly good news, but that was expected.
segments.zh: 嘿Mike。早上好John。这不算好消息，但也在预期之内。

segments.en: PPI for final demand on a month of a month basis, up 4.10 of 8%, puts the year-over-year number at 5.4%
segments.zh: 最终需求PPI环比上涨0.8%，同比达到5.4%。

segments.en: That is more than was anticipated. Ex-food and energy were up 2.10% of a percent a little bit less than expected.
segments.zh: 这高于预期。剔除食品和能源后上涨0.2%，略低于预期。

segments.en: And on a year-over-year basis, 4.6% bang on with the consensus forecast.
segments.zh: 同比4.6%，与共识预期完全一致。

segments.en: And then ex-food energy and trade up 3.10% as forecast.
segments.zh: 剔除食品、能源和贸易后上涨0.3%，符合预期。

segments.en: And that puts us at 4.7% for that as it was last month and as was expected.
segments.zh: 该指标同比为4.7%，与上月和预期一致。

segments.en: So still a lot of price pressure in the PPI's.
segments.zh: 所以PPI中仍存在较大的价格压力。

segments.en: One other number we just got. Initial jobless claims. 206,000 after a revised 207,000 last month.
segments.zh: 刚发布的另一个数据：初请失业金人数20.6万，上月修正后为20.7万。

segments.en: So no change on the labor market side. But something to keep an eye on.
segments.zh: 所以劳动力市场方面没有变化。但值得关注。

segments.en: And definitely when we're talking about inflation here, I was just talking with Omer Sharif of inflation insights.
segments.zh: 谈到通胀，我刚和通胀洞察的奥马尔·谢里夫交流过。

segments.en: And he pointed out that the August PPI numbers only include data through August 11th.
segments.zh: 他指出，8月PPI数据只包含截至8月11日的信息。

segments.en: So the big rise in oil prices we've seen and the big rise in diesel prices we've seen hasn't really been reflected in this.
segments.zh: 因此，我们看到的油价和柴油价格大幅上涨尚未真正反映在其中。

segments.en: And then you take a look at what's happening with oil prices today if that doesn't reverse.
segments.zh: 然后看看今天油价的情况，如果这没有逆转。

segments.en: It's all adds another layer of complexity to the Fed, which has to think now about, well, that's what's happening in August.
segments.zh: 这都给美联储增添了另一层复杂性，现在必须考虑，嗯，这就是8月的情况。
